transcript: Speaker A (Rani): yah order kahan se mila? [Where did you get this order?] Speaker B (AI): I get this from customer. Speaker A: I get this from customer nahi boliye, boliye, I got this order from a customer. Where do you sell your clothes rani? Speaker B: My shop is room. Speaker A: My shop is room nahi kahiye, kahiye, I run my clothing business from my room. Speaker B: Are wah! Mujhe English bolne mein bahut dar lagta tha ki koi galti na ho jaye. [Wow! [Just click on the link appearing below the video.] Speaker C (Presenter): Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: ME NO ENGLISH, Speakeasy AI, Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy, Install Now, GET IT ON Google Play, Download on the App Store
summary: A home-business owner named Rani practices English with a friendly AI avatar on the Speakeasy app. The AI corrects her grammar, explains that the app is highly affordable, and requires only 15 minutes of daily practice. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
